The Python source files are byte-identical published companion sources from bc-ai-ecosystem/training-your-own-models commit fb895e1a3e08fac86738106e6122bdcafb124e65, companion SHA256 e924589b152f68bb15d89b8f95e3b52005bbe4a9f7770f2d0550b5422d3a11d6. pins.json binds the exact bytes.

This qualification calls only retrieval_common.read_jsonl and the pure embedding_contract.format_query/sha256_file helpers, after independent bounded archive/schema/source/family validation. The retained lexical_baseline.py is source evidence only: never import or execute it, retrieval_metrics, model_fingerprint on model data, neural code, or any fitting/ranking/metrics/training path.

retrieval_fixture.py authors tiny compatibility texts and automated review actions. Explicit query refs are positives; every other query/document relation remains UNJUDGED, never an inferred negative. train_pairs is positive transport only and does not qualify downstream in-batch negatives. These authored controls establish no benchmark quality, actual human judgments, semantic split independence, or rights approval.

The QA oracle accepts at most 48 MiB physical ZIP bytes, 40 MiB complete logical payload bytes, 5,000 selected records, 5,005 regular stored ZIP members, 5,000 families and 50,000 total known source snapshots (at most 5,000 per family), and JSON nesting depth 64. ZIP EOCD and actual central record count are fenced before ZipFile builds its list; cumulative snapshot count is fenced before graph construction. These are bounded QA admission limits, not a broader import format. The live product remains the source authority.
